notablePrerequisites:
A Swamp and a Forest on the battlefield.
At least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate the Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb twice by sacrificing those two lands, gaining 4 life.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
Molderhulk, Necroduality, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a Molderhulk token.
The Molderhulk token and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Molderhulk trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything.
Repeat.
